sql.if: AND (employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO driver (company_id, employee_no, name, phone, password, vehicle_id, account_status) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{password}, #{vehicleId}, #{accountStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE driver SET company_id = #{companyId}, employee_no = #{employeeNo}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, password = #{password}, vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE driver SET account_status = #{accountStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE driver SET vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
